Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the cornerstones of the company. The activities are focused on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group and manages the server backend systems in two data centers together with the hybrid cloud infrastructure for approximately 10,000 users, who work at over 100 locations in Europe.
